overview.body: Ten traditional stone houses in Mavrikiano. One larger villa in Vrouchas. Choose by sea view, pool, outdoor space, access, and group size.

villa.heading: Almond Tree Villa in Vrouchas
villa.body: A larger 230 m² villa for up to 10 guests, with five sleeping rooms, two bathrooms, a private 9 m × 4 m pool, reed-shaded balconies, garden, and views toward the Cretan Sea, garden, pool, and mountains.
villa.imageAlt: Almond Tree Villa garden and private pool in Vrouchas

setting.body: The stone houses are in Mavrikiano, above Schisma, the harbour centre of Elounda. Almond Tree Villa is in Vrouchas, higher on the hillside and closer to Plaka. A car is recommended for beaches, tavernas, luggage, and evening meals.
